title: Backend unrestricted qualification and desktop account access boundaries
owner_policy: Keep matching historically verified local Installed shelf on known server token denial; show denial and block server actions. Preserve game files and saves.

backend_unrestricted.selection: All tests with no integration exclusion or CI deselections

confirmed_and_corrected: 401/403 heartbeat failures were classified as outages; typed HTTP denial now takes precedence even if its body names a network error.

Stopped and superseded heartbeat responses could dispatch commands or acknowledge with new credentials. Snapshot, revision and stopped guards prevent these completions, including A-to-B-to-A transitions.
Connection attempts retained previous-account titles and paths. Current-epoch display guards clear the old profile before validation; cache writes also check the epoch after hashing.
Heartbeat recovery re-enabled server actions on the old catalog. Identity and ACL-filtered search now refresh first; identity changes clear cached titles and stop recovery until explicit Connect.
Local profile forgetting was absent. Explicit forgetting clears local credentials/title cache, preserves games/saves/install records and reports partial persistence failures.
A pending credential write could repopulate a forgotten token. Serialized profile writes apply the later forget after the pending write.
A pending native process check could send playtime heartbeat after tracking stopped. Late stopped completions are discarded; explicit forgetting stops profile tracking without killing the game.

tests.selection: Unique source tests only; generated dist duplicates excluded

red_green.case: HTTP denial body network phrase precedence

runtime_scope: Actual desktop app DOM and real SDK with controlled Tauri adapters/API responses; real Node HTTP origin-to-sink redirect test. Browser opaque redirect responses also simulated. No installed Tauri/WebView acceptance claimed.
rulings: Use a desktop control-plane adapter with manual redirect refusal; leave shared requester and archive destination validation unchanged.
Connection switching/forgetting waits for busy local operations to finish or be cancelled. Native files remain OS-owned.
Local lifecycle persistence stays OS-owned; explicit server sync uses the current operation identity and current catalog-visible rows.
Forgetting does not revoke the remote token or clear independent site-window cookies; the UI discloses those boundaries.
rework: Private task helper required a space in task headings; corrected plan formatting, no product effect.
A recovery-stop assertion initially observed status before async hashing settled; request-count assertion reproduced the missing stop, then passed with the guard.
Initial tracking-forget fixture rejected native process polling and auto-stopped tracking, masking the defect; corrected running-process fixture reproduced it before the fix.
First API adjacency selection included source and generated dist duplicates:110 executions. Corrected source-only55 is the unique result reported.
First bundle command used an incorrect filename and ran no validator; corrected standalone validator passed.
UI builds warn about external output directories and an existing static/dynamic native import; both builds completed. Output stays in private review artifacts.
limits: 316 desktop cases and55 API cases do not establish server-side permission acceptance, route parity, real OS credential behavior or native platform lifecycle.
Offline cache still derives from the twelve-title library preview; complete Installed-shelf inventory remains open.
Actual native cold/offline/denial/reconnect/account switch, operation/restart/PID/filesystem journeys and official installed upgrade/rollback remain open.
Physical macOS/Linux/Steam Deck/headset and assistive-technology acceptance remain separate.
Current-source clean image build remains incomplete after a previous interrupted external archive wait; no clean-image or deployment claim.
Default-branch security alerts remain open pending gated merge and a subsequent recheck. No merge, release or deployment performed.
